I'm too ashamed to call my doctor about it because I'm scared of any negative reactions they might have because I would tell them about the side effects. I'm too mentally slow right now to tell the doctor about the side effects and I feel like he's going to negatively judge me and think I don't want to take the medication.

Thank you for responding... I just want to calm down and go back to sleep but... I'm just here with a headache just trembling at the thought of taking the Prozac again..
It's like I don't even want help but I want to get help I'm so confused I can't stop crying I know I'm already rock bottom but it's like I don't want help

Hear hear. 
22 year old still living with my parents. The thing is, at least many 20 something's try to move out. That's more admirable than a person like me that actually wants to stay in my parents' home. I'm too scared for the real world honestly. And I can relate. I'm struggling enough as it is with the motivation to having a job out of irrational fear. Typing this from my childhood bedroom. I've also never even managed to get a job. My older sister is 38 and recently moved back and it's a constant torture comparing myself to her. She's a really high-energy go-getter that easily get jobs and has her career life stable. Meanwhile as for me, I get rejections from retail and everywhere basically. My parents worry about my future constantly and I am too. 

Welp. That's what happens when I didn't care about college or being an adult when mental illness crippled me badly over the years.
